row_identity_tolerance_why: the $1 rounding tolerance (TJ, 29 Oct 2026) applied to a row's printed balance as to a column's printed total; rows say `within $1 rounding tolerance` (30 October 2026). TJ to confirm it should reach row identities
forward_lines_skip_own_why: a line whose AVAILABLE equals its own APPROPRIATED carries no forward line, so pending forward lines belong to a later line of the group (30 October 2026)
forward_lines_identity_why: an account's rft/fwd/mrt lines print in APPROPRIATED alone above it, and the TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE of the account or department subtotal they fund is its appropriation plus them: tested as that run's identity (30 October 2026). Set where the layout puts AVAILABLE on the account or department subtotal only: measured on 1991-2010, on 2004-2010 a mark line belongs to one of several lines printing AVAILABLE
debt_label_columns_why: the debt repayment schedule's column totals are checked against the rows their printed labels name (issue total = its principal and interest lines; GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL = every PRINCIPAL line; GRAND TOTAL INTEREST = every INTEREST line; TOTAL DEBT = the two), replacing the column walk, which sums GRAND TOTAL INTEREST over nothing (30 October 2026)
unlabeled_subtotal_blocks_why: the department block an unlabeled subtotal tied to, to the cent, is recorded as that department's own closed check, so its lines are not left to the GRAND TOTAL pages away (30 October 2026)
unlabeled_subtotals_forward_lines_why: a department's rft/mrt/fwd lines print in APPROPRIATED alone, so that column's block starts above EXPENDED's; the unlabeled subtotal is recognised when one line lies in every tying column's window (30 October 2026)
blank_balance_outside_subtotals_why: a one-line account outside any closed department subtotal strikes its balance on its own line, so a blank balance there is zero; inside a closing department subtotal it is not (30 October 2026)
debt_row_totals_why: the debt repayment schedule's TOTAL column is the sum of its fiscal-year columns on every row; the column walk sums GRAND TOTAL INTEREST over nothing (30 October 2026)
basis_source: the label `2000 Annual Town Report` (sources/town-annual-reports/index.csv); a calendar EDITION (p39: `during calendar year 2000`; p97 `DEATHS - 2000`), whose financial statements are for a fiscal year -- see periods
unlabeled_subtotals_why: the accountant schedule prints a department subtotal with no label; a row is read as one only when it equals, to the cent, the detail lines above it since the last total (29 October 2026)
